productArea.name: Repository management and policies
productArea.scope: Create and configure repositories, including general settings, units, visibility, collaborators, teams, branch and tag protections, deploy keys, optional Git hooks and LFS, archiving, transfer, and deletion. Webhooks, Actions settings, issue tracker configuration, and pull request defaults belong to other areas.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Settings in the seeded repository for general settings, archiving, transfer, and deletion.
Choose Units Overview to configure which repository units are available, leaving issue tracker configuration and pull request defaults to their own areas.
Choose Collaborators to manage user and team access.
Choose Branches to configure the default branch and protection rules.
Choose Tags to configure tag protection rules.
Choose Deploy Keys to manage repository keys.
Choose Git Hooks if server policy permits editing them.
Choose LFS to inspect files, pointers, and locks when the server enables LFS.
Choose New Repository from the + menu to configure an empty repository.
